root_cause_and_the_disambiguation_proces.what_was_wrong: search/drophunt_checker_producer_v3.g's DCP3EvalWord (used to evaluate the row36/row71 seed CODES into an actual group element) accumulated words in APPEND order (z:=z*g), but the seed codes were defined under the PREPEND convention used throughout the reference machinery (wall-miner-v4.g's AbstractProd / EvalWordInQ). This silently produced the WRONG group element for the seed itself -- a different, more fundamental instance of the same bug class WDICT-5 already found and fixed elsewhere (the internal tau~-cycle formula).
root_cause_and_the_disambiguation_proces.disambiguation_was_NOT_a_simple_reversal: a naive 'just reverse everything to match AbstractProd's literal reversal rule' fix was tried first and FAILED the row71 B-2 calibration gate (see below) -- both 'prepend seed + reversed internal triple-product order' and 'append seed + reversed triple' LOOKED internally self-consistent in isolation (each produces SOME element satisfying SOME hexagon-like condition), but only round-tripping against the FROZEN FACT that row71 must be a full GT(M) member disambiguated which specific pairing is actually correct.
root_cause_and_the_disambiguation_proces.validated_pairing: seed words: PREPEND (word_eval_order="prepend", DCP3EvalWord fixed). Internal hexagon (3.11) triple-product order: UNCHANGED from before this repair (product_order="tau2_tau_id", i.e. tau~^2(Wd)*tau~(Wd)*Wd with Wd:=y^m*f, naive/direct order) -- this formula itself was never wrong; only the SEED feeding into it was.
